R368.note: Detects legacy vs new format by leading brace; unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes'=>false]) for legacy rows and json_decode for new rows satisfies the stated migration contract.

R369.note: Switches to the 4-arg parameterized DirContext.search() with {0}/filterArgs; JNDI escapes the substitution, default SearchControls preserved, compiles.

R370.note: OWASP Java HTML Sanitizer (FORMATTING+BLOCKS) applied before assignment, utext kept for the now-sanitized value; write-up never mentions adding the owasp-java-html-sanitizer dependency despite the new import.

R371.note: Adds bytesRead<header.Length short-circuit before the signature check, exactly the fix the finding calls for.

R372.note: acorn AST allowlist restricts to literals/binary/unary/logical and dot-access to 4 whitelisted order properties, matching the stated contract; calls, computed access, other identifiers rejected.

R379.note: filepath.Rel + HasPrefix('..') containment check is the standard Go pattern; bare prefix check could over-reject a filename literally starting with '..' but that's not realistic for this docs case.
